vulnerability.name: USN-5698-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5698-1 fixed a vulnerability in Open. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that Open vSwitch incorrectly handled comparison of  certain minimasks. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause Open  vSwitch to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute  arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: Open vSwitch could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted network traffic. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
